verificationRequiredAfterActivation.unavailableDatabaseRule: Report BLOCKED, not PASS, if required real PostgreSQL verification cannot run.
verificationRequiredAfterActivation.targetedPolicy: Run the PAY-003 migration contract group and fresh/upgrade PostgreSQL group once; after a failure rerun only the smallest affected target. Do not run a repository-wide suite for this lease.

reservationSemantics: This document reserves only Payroll main V53 and the exact path. It is not an active lease and grants no migration write, source write, test, commit or push authority. A later append-only active-lease successor must hash-bind a materialized clean backend worktree, and a separate executable start token must bind that successor and the owner packet.
invalidationConditions: Payroll V53 or the exact leased path exists from another owner before the first authorized edit.
Payroll main high-water differs from V52 at worktree materialization.
The planned backend worktree path or branch exists with a different head, tree, upstream or non-empty porcelain.
Any table, key, index, policy or guard outside the resolved exact manifest is required.
An existing migration must change, a second Payroll migration is required or a data backfill becomes necessary.
